question: Will AfD win the most seats in the Baden-Württemberg Landtag election?
summary: Ensemble aggregate is 2%, serving as a low baseline.
Objections identify plausible tail risks: late surge, polling undercount, and regional concentration could modestly elevate AfD support or seat totals.
Historical patterns show AfD has not led BW in seats; top seat leadership typically goes to Greens or CDU, making a win improbable.
Calibrated upward to reflect tail-risk, resulting in a modest 5% probability with a plausible 2–10% uncertainty range.

justification.critique_assessment: Objections are valid as tail-risk factors but do not indicate a systematic error in the ensemble; they warrant a modest upward adjustment rather than a wholesale revision downward.
justification.adjustment: Raised from 0.02 to 0.05 to incorporate plausible tail-risk scenarios (late surge, undercounting, regional concentration) without implying a near-certain outcome; range set to 0.02–0.10 to reflect uncertainty.

forecasts.reference-class: Historical Baden-Württemberg Landtag elections with AfD participation (2016 and 2021). In both elections, Greens or CDU led in seats; AfD did not win the most seats (2016: Greens 47/143, CDU 42/143, AfD 23/143; 2021: Greens 58/154, CDU 42/154, AfD 0).

sources.claim: ZDF-Politbarometer Extra Baden-Württemberg (Feb 2026) shows CDU 27%, Greens 25%, AfD 19%.
Aggregated February 2026 polls place CDU around 27-28%, Greens around 25-27%, AfD around 18-20% (multiple polls).
2016 election: Greens 30.3% with 47 seats, CDU 27.0% with 42 seats, AfD 15.1% with 23 seats; Greens were the largest party.
2021 election: Greens 32.6% with 58 seats, CDU 24.1% with 42 seats, AfD 9.7% with 0 seats.
Infratest dimap poll (Feb 25–26, 2026): CDU 28%, Greens 27%, AfD 18%.
Projected parliamentary composition (INSA): CDU 36, Greens 28, AfD 26 seats.
Background: 2021 BW election Greens led with 32.6% (57 seats); AfD had 9.7% (17 seats).
May 2025 poll (may be behind paywall): CDU 31%, AfD 19%, Greens 20%.
Forschungsgruppe Wahlen poll (Feb 26, 2026) shows CDU 27%, Greens 25%, AfD 19%, SPD 9%, FDP 6%, Die Linke 6% (AfD not leading).
Infratest dimap poll (Feb 25, 2026) shows CDU 28%, Greens 27%, AfD 18%, SPD 7%, FDP 6%, Die Linke 5.5% (AfD not leading).

synthesis: The baseline forecast assigns AfD a very small chance of winning the most seats in Baden-Württemberg. While late surges and polling undercounts are credible tail risks, current polls and historical patterns keep the probability low; a modest adjustment to 5% captures these tail possibilities without overstating them.
